ba5b3737d333edd26e265e747196045c18b8d404.ja: # 決算検査報告の検証（2026-11-17 開始）　確認の状態：機械検証のみ
ba5b3737d333edd26e265e747196045c18b8d404.en: # Verification of the Audit Report (Board of Audit) (started 2026-11-17)　Verification status: Machine-verified only

5ed2a7b0563ad828bb8a8147ace10fa5efeb14c6.ja:
## 扱い方（r08 で決めた一案。この案で進めた）
- 決算検査報告は統計ではなく、会計検査院の指摘の集まりである。指摘の当否（不当かどうか、金額の算定が妥当か）は扱わない。
- 報告に載った数（件数・指摘金額・背景金額）を、統計表と同じ手順で検査する：L1（表の和）、L3（版間：前年度の報告と、翌年度の報告の推移の表）、L4（概要と本文）。
- 他の資料との突き合わせは、指摘で引用された各省の統計・白書の値を対象にする（今回は行っていない）。
- 区分の扱い：報告自体の数の食い違いは他の統計と同じ区分（誤り・不整合など）で記録する。指摘の内容に関わる主張は記録しない。
5ed2a7b0563ad828bb8a8147ace10fa5efeb14c6.en:
## Approach (one option decided in r08; work proceeded on this option)
- The Audit Report (Board of Audit) is not a statistic but a collection of the Board of Audit's observations. Whether the observations are justified (whether something is improper, whether the calculation of amounts is appropriate) is not addressed.
- The figures in the report (numbers of cases, amounts pointed out, background amounts) are checked with the same procedure as statistical tables: L1 (table sums), L3 (between editions: the previous fiscal year's report and the trend tables in the following fiscal year's report), L4 (summary and main text).
- Cross-checking against other sources covers the values of each ministry's statistics and white papers cited in the observations (not done this time).
- Handling of categories: discrepancies in the report's own figures are recorded with the same categories as other statistics (error, inconsistency, etc.). Claims concerning the content of the observations are not recorded.
